desc: Implement DP table `dp[o][e][par]` with INF cap and recurrence.
Build candidate lists per position respecting required parity.
Construct k-th lexicographic permutation by iterating candidates in ascending order, subtracting counts, and picking when k ≤ count.
Handle edge cases: n=1, k out of range, empty result.
Run unit tests on examples n=4,k=6; n=3,k=2; n=2,k=3; n=1,k=1; n=1,k=2; n=100,k=1 to ensure correct outputs.
If any test fails, debug DP or construction logic and fix the implementation.
Confirm final solution returns correct results for all cases and ensure time/space complexity is acceptable for n≤100, k≤10^15.
